eod.conclusion: Indian benchmarks closed lower after failing to maintain early gains, with the Nifty and Sensex both declining while Bank Nifty barely held ground. The session saw volatility as markets initially extended their winning streak before retreating, with attention turning to upcoming earnings reports. While domestic equities wavered, global developments including cryptocurrency surges and central bank policy complexities created crosscurrents across asset classes.
